 LIVE 1st T20I NZ vs Ind Updates: India break Mitchell-Phillips stand as Arshdeep strikes
   Thu, 22 October 2026 
 Refresh   
 13:41 
 1st T20I NZ vs Ind Updates: India break Mitchell-Phillips stand as Arshdeep strikes 
 Bhuvneshwar Kumar takes a catch of Daryl Mitchell 
 NZ 133-3 (13 Ovs) vs Ind | SCORECARD Time for a drinks break, with New Zealand threatening to regain the early momentum after India's breakthroughs.
Mayank Yadav returns to the attack, and Daryl Mitchell shuffles across to work the ball towards deep square leg for a single. Glenn Phillips also rotates the strike before Mitchell gets a reprieve. Mayank induces an edge, but Abhishek Sharma puts down a catch, leaving the bowler visibly disappointed. Phillips collects another single before Mitchell finishes the over with back-to-back boundaries. Twelve runs come off it as New Zealand reach 110/2 after 11 overs.
Nitish Kumar Reddy returns, and Phillips and Mitchell begin by exchanging singles. Phillips then gets down on one knee and smashes a huge six to keep the scoreboard moving. Tilak Varma makes a sliding stop but fumbles, allowing the batters to take two runs. Twelve runs come off the over as New Zealand reach 122/2 after 12 overs.
Arshdeep Singh returns to the attack and strikes immediately! Daryl Mitchell looks to take on the left-arm pacer but finds Bhuvneshwar Kumar, who takes the catch safely. Mitchell departs for 28 off 19 balls, handing India a timely breakthrough. 
 Bevon Jacobs is the new batter and makes an instant impact, launching a six off his first delivery! He follows it up with a single, while Glenn Phillips drives along the ground to long-off for another run. A dot ball is followed by two more singles to close the over.  
 11 runs and a wicket come off it as New Zealand reach 133/3 after 13 overs. 
 13:26 
 1st T20I NZ vs Ind Updates: Phillips, Mitchell keep NZ's scoring rate up 
 NZ 98-2 (10 Ovs) vs Ind | SCORECARD Nitish Kumar Reddy is brought into the attack. Glenn Phillips looks to flick the first delivery but gets a leading edge towards cover and fails to score. He then nudges the ball towards wide mid-on, where Reddy moves quickly to keep the batters down to a single.
The batters rotate the strike with singles through the rest of the over. Five runs come off it as New Zealand reach 86/2 after nine overs.
Axar Patel continues, and Phillips works the ball through square leg, but the batters wisely decide against a second run. Daryl Mitchell gets forward and knocks the ball down to long-off for a single before the batters collect a couple more runs.
Phillips finishes the over in style, charging down the track and launching a massive six into the stands. Twelve runs come off the over as New Zealand reach 98/2 after 10 overs.
 13:16 
 1st T20I NZ vs Ind Updates: Axar strikes! Finn Allen departs for 45 
 NZ 81-2 (8 Ovs) vs Ind | SCORECARD Axar Patel continues, and Finn Allen welcomes him with a massive six straight down the ground. Allen then makes room to chip the ball towards long-off for a single. He wants a second run but has to settle for one. Daryl Mitchell follows with a wristy shot through mid-on for another single.
Axar strikes on the next delivery! Finn Allen goes for another big hit but fails to get hold of it. Tilak Varma settles under the mistimed shot and takes the catch. The dangerous Allen departs for a quickfire 45 off 24 balls, giving India a crucial breakthrough.
Glenn Phillips is the new batter. 
 Glenn Phillips stays back and stabs the ball towards midwicket before nudging the next delivery into the covers for a single to get off the mark.  
 Nine runs and a wicket come off the over as New Zealand reach 81/2 after eight overs. 
 13:14 
 1st T20I NZ vs Ind Updates: Allen, Mitchell launch sixes 
 NZ 65-1 (7 Ovs) vs Ind | SCORECARD Axar Patel comes into the attack, and Finn Allen welcomes him with a maximum. Allen then backs away and cuts the ball for three runs before Daryl Mitchell gets off the mark with a six of his own.  
 A single off the final delivery takes New Zealand to 65/1 at the end of the powerplay, with 16 runs coming off the over.
Mayank Yadav continues, and Mitchell collects a single before Allen drills one back down the ground, only for the ball to hit the stumps at the non-striker's end. A wide follows, and Allen responds with a boundary. He fails to connect with a scoop attempt before pulling the next delivery for a single. Mitchell finds Axar at backward point to end the over with a dot ball.  
 Seven runs come off it as New Zealand reach 72/1 after seven overs. 
 13:02 
 1st T20I NZ vs Ind Updates: Mayank strikes! Seifert falls after flying start 
 NZ 49-1 (5 Ovs) vs Ind | SCORECARD Arshdeep Singh continues, but Finn Allen takes him on, smashing three consecutive boundaries to put India under pressure. Allen adds a single before Tim Seifert collects another four, making it a 17-run over for the second time in a row.  
 New Zealand race to 46 without loss after four overs.
Mayank Yadav comes into the attack and strikes in his first over! After conceding a couple of runs and a single to Allen, Mayank keeps Seifert quiet with two deliveries before the opener attempts a slash and edges it behind. Sanju Samson takes a safe catch, ending Seifert's innings at 24 off 17 balls.  
 Just three runs and a wicket come off the over as New Zealand reach 49/1 after five overs. 
 12:51 
 1st T20I NZ vs Ind Updates: Allen, Seifert give NZ flying start 
 NZ 29-0 (3 Ovs) vs Ind | SCORECARD 
 Arshdeep Singh comes on from the other end, with a slip in place, as he plays his 100th T20I. Finn Allen and Tim Seifert rotate the strike with singles before Allen beats the diving fielder to his right to smash the first boundary of the match. He adds another single, while Seifert picks up one before a dot ball ends the over.  
 New Zealand reach 12 without loss after two overs, with eight coming off Arshdeep's first.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar continues, and Seifert initially defends before the bowler oversteps to concede a no-ball. Seifert swings and misses, with Sanju Samson taking the ball behind the stumps.  
 The opener finally gets a boundary off Bhuvneshwar after being troubled by the veteran pacer early on. He follows it with another four, making room to slap the ball past mid-off, before both batters rotate the strike. Seifert then launches a massive six to cap a productive over.  
 17 runs come off it, taking New Zealand to 29 without loss after three overs. 
 12:41 
 1st T20I NZ vs Ind Updates: Seifert survives run-out scare 
 NZ 4-0 (1 Ovs) vs Ind |  SCORECARD 
 Bhuvneshwar Kumar opens the attack for India, with Tim Seifert and Finn Allen at the crease. Seifert is beaten by some early swing before getting off the mark with a single towards mid-off.
A direct hit from Axar Patel at the keeper's end leads to a run-out review, but Seifert is safe after a dive. Allen gets off the mark with a single towards point, before Seifert picks up a couple off the final delivery.  
 Four runs come off the opening over. 
 12:15 
 1st T20I NZ vs Ind Updates: India opt to bowl first in Christchurch 
 Shreyas Iyer and Mitchell Santner at the toss 
 India captain Shreyas Iyer confirmed two changes, with Nitish Kumar Reddy replacing Shivam Dube and Mayank Yadav coming in for Prince Yadav.
New Zealand captain Mitchell Santner said his side would have bowled first as well, adding that the fresh pitch looked good for batting.
"We've got a couple of guys missing, but I think the depth we have at the moment is really, really good," Santner said.
New Zealand are without Jacob Duffy, Kyle Jamieson and Devon Conway, but will field four seamers, similar to India.
 Here are the playing XIs
India: Sanju Samson(w), Abhishek Sharma, Ishan Kishan, Shreyas Iyer(c), Tilak Varma, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Naman Dhir, Axar Patel, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Arshdeep Singh, Mayank Yadav
 New Zealand: Finn Allen, Tim Seifert(w), Daryl Mitchell, Glenn Phillips, Bevon Jacobs, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner(c), Nathan Smith, Adam Milne, Matt Henry, Lockie Ferguson
 12:03 
 1st T20I NZ vs Ind Updates: India opt to bowl first in Christchurch 
 Mitchell Santner and Shreyas Iyer are out in the middle for the toss. Santner flips the coin, and India win the toss and elect to field.
 12:00 
 1st T20I NZ vs Ind: Can Shreyas crack New Zealand's T20I challenge? 
 Captain Shreyas Iyer with Coach Gautam Gambhir. 
 India face a fresh challenge in Christchurch on Wednesday, with little time to recover from a packed schedule at home and adapt to New Zealand conditions.  
 Just four days after their rain-hit T20I series against the West Indies ended in Bengaluru, Shreyas Iyer's side must quickly switch gears for a demanding tour.
The Asian Games in Japan concluded on October 3, followed by five T20Is against the West Indies across India. Now, Shreyas Iyer's side must quickly adapt to unfamiliar conditions, with travel fatigue adding to the challenge.
New Zealand tours are never straightforward, and early-season conditions could test India's batters and bowlers. The last 200-plus T20I total in New Zealand came nine matches ago, underlining the difference from the high-scoring contests India have been involved in at home.
India last faced New Zealand in the T20 World Cup final in Ahmedabad in March, when they piled up 255. Much has changed since, with Iyer taking over the captaincy and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi still looking to cement his place after his international debut.
India's bowling attack also has a familiar face in Bhuvneshwar Kumar, recalled after impressive IPL performances.
However, Jasprit Bumrah has been rested with the Test series in mind, while Hardik Pandya remains unavailable for international duty.
